parsed.note_claim: When including both goods and services, the U.S. trade deficit with Canada has averaged significantly less than $60B annually over the last decade.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The US has had a trade deficit with Canada every year from 2021 through 2025. The 2025 deficit was $27.35 billion, a decrease from 2024's deficit of $39.4 billion.
